title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
【脑子放置处，作者的脑子已经放在这里了！】【写在前言，可能前期节奏比较慢。毕竟还是以日常和培育为主。】下面是正文。.........林枫的精灵高考成绩一半好，一半坏。所以，他十分钟之前，正在经历人生的重大选择当中。是成为一名培育家，还是放弃父母留下来的培育屋，成为一名训练家？这是一个非常严峻的问题。但现在，他没有再纠结了。【叮，检测到宿主穿越十八年，防沉迷系统解除，宝可梦愉悦值系统开启，只要使宝可梦愉悦起来，便能获得相对应的奖励】【现奖励宿主神级常磐之力，神级培育家技术以及相关副职业大师级技术！】【另补偿宿主探查之眼技能，真新人体质技能。】【神级常磐之力：拥有着感知，治疗，疗愈宝可梦情绪的力量！】【神级培育家：能够化腐朽为神奇，将最简单的秘物最大限度利用，并且制造出来的食物具有料理效果。】【探查之眼：能够检测到任何事物的本质，并且以数据化出现在宿主的眼中。【真新人体质：身体素质大幅度上升，削弱宝可梦技能99.99.....%的伤害，并且会与达成羁绊的宝可梦共享一部分体质。】这是刚刚林枫身上发生的事情。胎穿越到这个宝可梦的平行世界已经十八年了。十八年的功夫，他原本已经对系统已经彻底死心了。没曾想，原来它只是迟到了……梧桐市下附属城镇——梧桐镇，这是林枫所在的小镇，清晨的阳光轻柔的洒进窗户，揉进几分浅碎的光影。

这是一间完全由树木搭建而成的小屋，在门的正上方，挂着“邻家培育屋”几个凌冽的大字。林枫还记得，这是由父亲的飞天螳螂用连斩刻下的字迹。只是现在已经落满了灰尘。在十年前，他的父母二人在探索一间精灵原野区的时候失踪。当时仅八岁的林枫，就被联盟通知你家爸妈没了。联盟原本打算将林枫送到孤儿院。可好歹也是穿越过来的灵魂，林枫拒绝了这项安排，并且第一时间脱手了培育屋中的精灵蛋，将其平价卖给联盟，获得了第一笔资金。撑到了十八岁，还余下不少的钱，够他选择初始宝可梦，迈向成为训练家的第一步！只是，如此之后，这间培育屋，便也没了存在的必要。可毕竟也是这一世父母的心血，想要一下子舍弃，林枫有些不舍。现在，既然系统来了，便没有这么多考究了。直接选培育家！“愉悦宝可梦获得奖励？”林枫有些心动。这个获取奖励的方法，实在太适合开培育屋了。感受到脑海中出现的神级培育知识还有数据之眼。他只觉得现在的自己强的可怕。“所以，收拾收拾，重新将培育屋开起来吧...”说是收拾，其实也就是打扫一下卫生而已。“然后，去尝试一下愉悦宝可梦？”林枫站起身来，走出房门。入眼是青石铺就的宽敞路道，沿着路道再走一段距离，则是一片青绿色的稻田，在稻田旁边的土地旁，一名老伯，正在和穿山鼠犁地，似乎还在播种着什么。这就是梧桐镇，一个靠近市区，但却仍然过着自给自足的小镇！“真新人体质，让我的视力也增强了吗？”这可隔着数百米的距离，但林枫甚至能看见穿山鼠身上的鳞片。林枫走向他，“这么早就出来干活了吗？秦爷爷？”被称为秦爷爷的老伯就穿着一件黄白色，有些褴褛的背心，脸上还带着劳作时的一块泥土。他随手一抹，那泥土覆盖的面积更大了，在脸上留下了一片痕迹。“嗯？小枫呀，这不是时节到了吗？准备种点辣番果，你也知道，身边这家伙，就喜欢吃点辣的！”老伯用脚轻轻踹了一下身边的穿山鼠，眼底闪过慈善的光芒。
content_en:
[Where the brain is placed, the author’s brain has been placed here!】【Written in the preface, the pace may be slower in the early stage.After all, it’s still about daily routine and cultivation.】The following is the text..........Lin Feng's elf college entrance examination results were half good and half bad.So, ten minutes ago, he was going through a major choice in his life.Should he become a breeder, or give up the breeding house left by his parents and become a trainer?This is a very serious problem.But now, he doesn't worry about it anymore.[Ding, it is detected that the host has traveled through eighteen years, the anti-addiction system is lifted, and the Pokémon happiness value system is turned on. As long as you make the Pokémon happy, you can get the corresponding rewards] [The host is now rewarded with god-level Viridian power, god-level breeder skills, and related sub-professional master-level skills!】【In addition, the host's probing eye skills and the true newcomer's physical skills are compensated.】【God-level Viridian Power: Has the power to sense, treat, and heal Pokémon's emotions!】【God-level cultivator: able to turn decay into magic, make the most of the simplest secrets, and the food produced has cooking effects.】【Eye of Exploration: Able to detect the essence of anything and appear in the eyes of the host as data.[True Newcomer Physique: Physical fitness is greatly increased, weakening the damage of Pokémon's skills by 99.99...%, and sharing part of the physique with the Pokémon that has achieved the bond.】This is what happened to Lin Feng just now.It has been eighteen years since I traveled to this parallel world of Pokémon.After eighteen years, he had completely given up on the system.I never thought that it turned out that it was just late... Wutong Town, an affiliated town under Wutong City, is the town where Lin Feng lives. The early morning sunshine softly shines through the windows, mixing in some shallow light and shadow.

This is a hut made entirely of trees. Right above the door, there are the bold characters "Next Door Cultivation House" hanging.Lin Feng still remembered that this was the handwriting carved by his father's flying mantis with continuous slashes.It's just now gathering dust.Ten years ago, his parents disappeared while exploring an elven wilderness area.Lin Feng, who was only eight years old at the time, was informed by the alliance that his parents were gone.The alliance originally planned to send Lin Feng to an orphanage.But after all, he was a soul that had traveled through time. Lin Feng rejected this arrangement and immediately sold the elf eggs in the breeding house, selling them to the alliance at a fair price, and obtained the first tranche of funds.When he reached the age of eighteen, he still had a lot of money left, enough for him to choose a starter Pokémon and take the first step towards becoming a trainer!However, after this, there is no need for this cultivation house to exist.But after all, it was the hard work of his parents in this life, so if he wanted to give it up all at once, Lin Feng was a little reluctant to give up.Now, since the system is here, there is no need to pay so much attention to it.Choose a breeder directly!"Pleasure Pokémon is rewarded?" Lin Feng was a little excited.This method of obtaining rewards is really suitable for opening a breeding house.Feel the god-level cultivation knowledge and data eyes appearing in your mind.He just feels that he is terrifyingly strong now."So, let's clean up and open the breeding house again..." It's called tidying up, but in fact it's just cleaning."Then, go try the Pleasure Pokémon?" Lin Feng stood up and walked out of the room.What comes into view is a spacious road paved with bluestones. Walking a little further along the road, there is a green rice field. Next to the rice field, an old man is plowing the land with the mountain rats, and seems to be sowing something.This is Wutong Town, a small town close to the city but still living a self-sufficient life!"Has the newbie's physique also enhanced my eyesight?" It was hundreds of meters away, but Lin Feng could even see the scales on the mountain rat.Lin Feng walked towards him, "Are you out working so early? Grandpa Qin?" The old man known as Grandpa Qin was wearing a yellow-white, somewhat ragged vest, with a piece of dirt from working on his face.He wiped it casually, and the soil covered an even larger area, leaving a mark on his face."Huh? Xiaofeng, isn't it the season? Get ready to plant some spicy berries. You know, this guy next to me likes to eat spicy food!" The old man lightly kicked the pangolin next to him with a gleam of charity in his eyes.
